title: Constraint: Power of Four
constraints: `v` (32 bits) must be a power of 4: 1, 4, 16, …, 2³⁰. All 16 values should appear (the testbench needs ≥ 15 in 300 calls).
Runs on Verilator with the z3 solver (`sudo pacman -S z3`).
hints: Power of two: exactly one bit set, `(v & (v - 1)) == 0` and `v != 0`.
Power of four: that bit is at an even position, `v & 32'h5555_5555`.
